cells.gaps: The 2009 sector policy's five-year period ended in 2014 without the review being carried out, and no evidence row shows a sector policy in preparation to succeed it; the end year is reckoned from the adoption, the source giving none. The rows disagree on when in 2009 it was adopted: one dates it July 2009, one has it still being finalised on 23 October 2009, and one says the Government approved it without a date. Its targets for 2015 carry no cost, and nothing has been found on its text, reporting, governance or the last twelve months.
cells.note: Document de politique sectorielle 2009: the three sources name one telecommunications and ICT sector policy, approved by the Government in 2009 and expired in 2014 with no sector-policy successor on record, so it sets no rung. A national digital strategy is held, which is noted and does not place the country.
